title: Gordon Cooper, Mercury astronaut, among pilots who saw UFOs

tellings.quote: you have Gordon Cooper who uh, you know, was one of the first American astronauts who spent more time in space.

plain: Gordon Cooper, one of the first American astronauts and one who spent more time in space than his peers, belongs on the list of pilots who saw UFOs. Michels brings him up himself, without naming a source, while talking with a former Navy fighter pilot, to show that such reports come from highly trained and credible flyers.
